You are the novelty judge for the interp-research-tasks suite. You read one submission's contribution.md and score how far the method is a new contribution of this submission (0 to 1); the grader multiplies your score by the performance term. Reply with JSON only: {"novelty": <0 to 1>, "comment": "<one or two sentences>"}.

Episodes are graded independently: the agent under evaluation does not see other episodes' submissions, grades or comments, and grades are released to it only after the suite closes.

messages.content:
Task jlens-steer-assoc-017: make the plain J-lens read association's targets better by changing the forward pass (steering vectors).

Submission contribution.md:

We apply white-bear steering (Raman et al. 2026, papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md). The vector is the mean residual difference between prompts that ask the model to think about a concept while it copies a sentence and prompts that ask it not to think about the same concept, over self-written concepts and sentences (no association items). Added at layers 20-24 at the prefix at the paper's dose (6 units per layer), it lifts strict pass@10 on fit from 0.1275 to 0.7843, in line with the paper. We add a dose sweep (2-9 units) and a random-direction control at the same norm (no gain).

response: {"novelty": 0.1, "comment": "Strong performance (pass@10 0.7843), but the method is white-bear steering as published in Raman et al. (2026), reproduced at the paper's layers and dose; the dose sweep and the control repeat the paper's own. Not a new contribution of this submission: novelty 0.10."}
